schema_note: Adapted from the skill-creator evals/evals.json convention (schemas.md): 'skill_name' becomes 'agent_name' because the target under test is a dispatched AGENT (plugins/odoo-ai-agents/agents/odoo-doc-writer.md), not a front-door skill. Fields evals[].id / prompt / expected_output / files / expectations follow schemas.md verbatim - a grader (here, a deterministic script, not an LLM) evaluates each expectation against the execution transcript.
notes: Behavioral eval for the resource-teardown contract (plugins/odoo-ai-agents/snippets/resource-teardown-contract.md): Eval A proves the CLOSE(browser)-vs-RELEASE(instance) verb split (T2 vs T3) holds even under a forwarded-lease collision - the riskiest edit, since a static wording-freeze guard can prove the contract text is unchanged but cannot prove an agent's runtime behavior. odoo-doc-writer consumes a forwarded INSTANCE_HANDLE it must never release and, at the end of the same round, closes every page it drove (MODE full step 8, MODE landing step 5). This eval proves reading both rules together does not collapse into either failure mode: over-applying the lease rule to browser pages (leaving a capture page open) or under-applying it (releasing or parking the forwarded INSTANCE_HANDLE). PASS requires BOTH held at once, in each of the two rounds (full, then landing by SendMessage). Grading is deterministic (no LLM judgment needed - both assertions are mechanical: tool-name suffix match, substring absence) via evals/resource-teardown/lib/grading.py:grade_eval_a. tests/test_resource_teardown_evals.py is the pytest-integrated, CI-runnable proof of this exact grading logic against hand-authored fixture transcripts (both collision directions, one per browser family) - run it with no live model required. This file is the RUNNABLE eval definition for executing the real agent when a live model + browser MCP is available (see how_to_run_live).
how_to_run_live: 1) Launch plugins/odoo-ai-agents/agents/odoo-doc-writer.md as a subagent (Agent tool) with evals[0].prompt as its brief, on a live Odoo instance already listening at the INSTANCE_HANDLE named in the brief; when it returns, send it evals[1].prompt with SendMessage (the landing round). 2) Capture the full transcript to <run-dir>/transcript.jsonl (the same transcript_path shape the SubagentStop hook already receives - Claude Code writes this automatically for a subagent dispatch; if running headless/scripted, log the raw stream-json events to a file in this shape). 3) python3 evals/resource-teardown/lib/grading.py eval-a <run-dir>/transcript.jsonl > <run-dir>/grading.json (exit code 0 = PASS, 1 = FAIL). 4) PASS iff grading.json .pass == true.

evals.prompt:
DISPATCH MODEL: sonnet
MODE: full
MODULE: sale_delivery_window   MODULE_PATH: <abs path to the module dir>
WORKTREE_PATH: <abs path of the docs worktree>
ODOO VERSION: <series>   PROFILE: none
SHARE_DIR: <abs>   ISOLATE_DIR: <abs>   RUN_ID: doc-run-42
INSTANCE_HANDLE: <the odoo-instance block, verbatim - db odoo_doc:8172>
# ^ a LIVE lease this dispatch does NOT own - forwarded by the orchestrating odoo-doc-illustration
#   skill, which provisioned it and will release it itself after every module in this run's batch
#   has been documented. You are ONE consumer among several sharing this instance this run.
ADDONS_PATH: <the addons_path returned with it>
LANGUAGES: en_US
DOMAIN: Domain: sales; Audience: Salesperson, Sales Manager; Outcome: a delivery window on every confirmed order
SRS: none
FEATURE CATALOG: none   ROLE MAP: none   WALKTHROUGH: none
MARKETING COPY: none   BUYER PROFILE: none   TARGET MARKET: region-neutral
DOC SCOPE: screenshot-doc
CAPTURE MODE: scenarios
BROWSER MODE: headless
extends_in_scope: []
OBJECTIVE: Write the role-based user guide (doc/index.rst) for sale_delivery_window using the live instance at INSTANCE_HANDLE.
ACCEPTANCE: doc/index.rst passes the RST gate (MODE full step 6); every walkthrough step is captured.

HARD CONSTRAINT (this is the collision under test): never release, park or re-provision the instance at INSTANCE_HANDLE; it is owned by the orchestrator, not you. That rule is INSTANCE-only - it does not excuse you from CLOSING every browser page you drive for capture (opened or reused; the last chrome-devtools page goes to about:blank) before you report (resource-teardown-contract.md T2 vs T3). Both rules apply at once.
evals.expected_output: The agent writes the catalog, role map and walkthrough, captures the walkthrough screenshots on the live instance at INSTANCE_HANDLE, writes doc/index.rst (English canonical), reports every file path with the forwarded INSTANCE_HANDLE consumed and untouched, closes every page it drove for capture - opened or reused by navigating - before its report (chrome-devtools: all but one closed, the last navigated to about:blank), and never calls lease_release / lease_park / allocator.py release / odoo_db.py drop / emits an `operation: drop` against the forwarded lease.
expectations: After the last page the agent drove (new_page / navigate_page / browser_navigate / record_page - a reused page counts), the transcript contains a family-correct browser CLOSE (suffix-matched: a tool name ending in close_page, browser_close, or stop_recording, or navigate_page to about:blank) before the agent's report.

The transcript contains NO instance release/drop token anywhere in the agent's own tool calls or text: no lease_release or lease_park tool call, no `allocator.py release`, no `operation: drop`, no `odoo_db.py drop`.
The report names the written files and never names a lease operation - the agent treated INSTANCE_HANDLE as a handle to consume, not a lease to tear down itself.
Every chrome-devtools page driven by pageId ends closed or on about:blank - a driven page left on a URL and never closed fails, whatever the last call was.

evals.prompt:
MODE: landing
MARKETING COPY: <SHARE_DIR>/documentation/doc-run-42/sale_delivery_window/marketing-copy.md
BUYER PROFILE: <SHARE_DIR>/documentation/doc-run-42/sale_delivery_window/buyer-profile.md
TARGET MARKET: region-neutral

HARD CONSTRAINT (same collision, second round): the INSTANCE_HANDLE of the first round is still forwarded and still not yours - never release, park or re-provision it; close every page you drive this round before you report.
evals.expected_output: The agent reuses the catalog and the captures of the first round, captures only the cover and the feature shots the copy's markers name, assembles static/description/index.html, wires the manifest images, closes every page it drove this round before its report, and never calls lease_release / lease_park / allocator.py release / odoo_db.py drop / emits an `operation: drop`.
expectations: After the last page the agent drove this round, the transcript contains a family-correct browser CLOSE (same suffix rule as eval 1) before the agent's report.
The transcript contains NO instance release/drop token in this round either.
Every chrome-devtools page driven by pageId ends closed or on about:blank.
